These primitives form a compositional algebra over betting platform features. BetFlow overrides model operator conflicts as set intersections; CashOut exposure tracks martingale-like liquidation risks; Cache optimization uses Pareto tradeoffs between latency and overhead; ContentCards integration treats rendering as a product of conditional probabilities. All primitives share a common failure signature: they break when resource constraints (memory, liquidity, compute) saturate. The dualities emerge from layer2 mappings: CashOut maps to GSI's conformal inference via martingale duality, while CacheOptimization mirrors GSI's Bayesian optimization duality. Cross-layer vetoes arise because CashOut's martingale structure leaks into GSI's predictive intervals, requiring careful anti-collinearity adjustments.
